items.title: Anime Village
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Play in Anime Village, a beautiful feudal anime inspired world! Explore a grand temple surrounded by a cozy town, sit in the hot springs, farm or claim one of the village homes! Enjoy custom stone and paper lanterns! Walk over rivers winding through terrace farms and explore the scenic trails to Panda Island. Perfect for anime fans and roleplayers!

- Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: RLCraft Bedrock Edition 1.3
items.creator: Honeyfrost
items.description:
RLCraft is here. It's hardcore. It's unforgiving. It's unfair. It's the hardest, most realistic Dynamic World out there! GLHF.

- Explore new world generation with structures & dungeons
- Progress on skills & wield powerful new gear
- Custom player & weapon animations
- Elemental dragons 
- Based on the original RLCraft Modpack by Shivaxi
- You're going to die... a lot
items.changelog:
RLCraft BE's 1.3 Update features:
- Mowzie's Mobs Compatibility: Frostmaw, Ferrous Wroughtnaut and Umvuthi unlock new Ascended Forms!
- Major Improvement's to combat, temperature and limb systems
- Improved game stability
- Bug fixes, Balancing, and much more!

Full changelog: discord.gg/honeyfrost

items.title: Epic Kill Animations 1.2
items.creator: Hog5kull
items.description:

items.changelog:
v1.2
- PVP ANIMATIONS: Kill animations now play in Player vs Player battles.
- ANNOUNCEMENTS: Epic voice lines like "Finish Them!" with volume control.
- MUSIC THEMES: Choose between Turbo Rock or Fantasy.
- DISABLE PARTICLES: Toggle off particle effects for a cleaner look.
